exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: historical Silent Storm softly painted COLOR facial overlay bitmap, not a photograph or new face.

Input1 is the exact ENTIRE native128square source RGBA, with its variable original alpha. Input2 is identical whole original storedRGB NEAREST6x768 source-only enlargement. Keep the COMPLETE full square color bitmap edge-to-edge at EXACT same normalized UV. Only restrained fine source paint, no new anatomy or reconstruction. Preserve original soft blur, every original pigment footprint/position/count/phase, relative weak washes, palette and expression. Original COMPLETE alpha will be independently restored; brightness only one global scalar. Do not invent an alpha cutout or fit/crop individual shapes.

Keep the ENTIRE nearly constant DARK BROWN original canvas. The actual source is deliberately almost invisible, RGB whole MIN[64,30,12] MAX[73,38,20], not a visible face render. Preserve exactly its very faint brown face-like wash centered native39..90,y38..82, faint paired eye washes and faint closed mouth wash WITHOUT making them more visible, outlined, anatomical or structured. Use a nearly flat brown field with only those exact original tiny low-contrast pigment variations. Do not replace the original subtle wash with a completely flat fill; do not invent new pores, beard hairs, nostrils, cheeks, lips, wrinkles, skin contours or a reconstructed face. Do not add any grain/mottle or specular highlights. Native sourceA0..232 is preserved separately, never enlarge/contrast-enhance the barely visible source.

Exact original whole RGB extrema are [[64, 30, 12], [73, 38, 20]]; preserve its muted pigment hierarchy, especially weak fields. No photoanatomy/photofibers/pores/radialpattern/mosaic/newglints/hair/teeth/curls/raised rims or cosmetic glare. No text/logo, hardware, new geometry, local highlighting or sharper edges.

Output the whole source square with same normalized UV, no margins/whitespace/padding/crop/zoom/BBox/rearrangement/sourceRGB artistic repairs. Keep original blur, paint scale, expression and weak source marks. Entire sourceA and default padding restored downstream, not by inventing new alpha.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Whole native storedRGBA to opaqueRGB NEAREST6x only, no crop/BBox/registration/padding/rotate/unpremultiply/sourceartRGB repair. Original fullA separately restored; ENTIRE raw inverse original4x/pure scalar/defaultpad.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
